chunks: And ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"People have only been commanded to come to these stones and circumambulate them, then come to us, inform us of their wilayah, and present to us their support."

key_terms.الْأَحْجَارَ: the stones, referring here to the stones of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.بِوَلَايَتِهِمْ: with their allegiance and acknowledgment of rightful authority
key_terms.فَيَطُوفُوا: that they circumambulate, referring to tawaf around the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith connect tawaf of the Kaʿbah with the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith links the outward rite of circumambulating the Kaʿbah with devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It presents worship at the Sacred House as inseparable from acknowledging their wilayah and offering support to their cause.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3139 - Umar ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurara, who narrated from Abu Ja’far (as), who said:
"People have been commanded to come to these stones, to circumambulate around them, and then come to us to inform us of their allegiance and present their support to us."
